name: Calle Silvia 2-20 and 22-44 ramp-and-steps covered passages: photo-relative study
frame: photo-relative: x to the left when looking in from the lane, z into the passage from the lane mouth (z=0, lane level); no world-map transform
trust: Read from full-size photos only. The plaques identify two passages on Calle de Silvia (2-20 and 22-44) that share one entrance type: a covered porch whose floor is raised by three white-nosed terracotta steps, with a red studded rubber ramp beside them, then brown panelled double doors on both walls with a barred window beside each, a pebble-mosaic mat, an arch and a garden beyond. Every dimension below is an estimate read against the doors (about 2.3 m) and the 0.3 m lane tiles; the riser height and ramp slope in particular are unmeasured. Not placed in the main map: see identity.

identity.2-20: IMG_2669 and IMG_2670 (plaque '2 20', garden-gate arch and the two large potted plants). Camera pins -118.9,116.3 and -118.4,115.3 (+/-2.7 m) at the mouth of the Silvia lane's west side, heading 242. The main map's west-side Silvia tunnel (data/silvia_map.json) sits at the same place and heading but is built from the CALLE SILVIA 1-15 photos IMG_2190/2191/2668, which were taken from the same pin looking the other way (heading 55-56); the 1-15 passage (louvred brown doors, schefflera pots, no ramp or steps) is therefore probably the east-block passage that IMG_2672-2674 show, and the west side is the 2-20 type built here. Left open for the owner: data/areas.json seaward-lanes notes and follow-up task silvia-west-passage-swap.
identity.22-44: IMG_2656, IMG_2657, IMG_2658 (plaque '22 44 CALLE DE SILVIA'), seen from the lane at IMG_2574 and IMG_2575. Camera pin -103.7,147.8 (+/-2.7 m), heading 238; the flight stands about 3 m ahead of IMG_2574 (looksAt -104.6,147.8). It lies on the same WSW line as the Patricia passage cameras IMG_2565-2570, so it is probably that passage's lane-end mouth, but the chain of arches between them has not been traced.

flight.trust: Three risers are read directly (IMG_2657, IMG_2669, IMG_2574). Riser height 0.15 m and tread 0.55 m are estimates from the door and the 0.3 m terracotta tiles; Elena's matching entrance reads two 0.15-0.18 m risers in data/levels_survey.json. The ramp runs beside the whole flight and about one tread further, so its slope (about 1:4) is a steep estimate. Dark grey edge bands run along each tread's nosing and the landing's near edge.

doors.trust: Dark brown panelled double doors (two raised panels per leaf) on both walls, as in IMG_2656, 2669 and 2670. Positions along the passage are estimates; the doors are closed and carry no knob detail. This differs from the louvred single doors of the 1-15 passage.

windows.trust: A tall barred window (square dark grille, slightly narrower than the door) beside each door at the first change of wall depth.

pebbleMat.trust: IMG_2656/2669/2670: a dark pebble-mosaic mat between the doors and the arch, about 1.5 m wide.

plaques.trust: IMG_2656 reads '22 44 CALLE DE SILVIA' as a vertical stack of dark tiles on the left wall; IMG_2670 reads '... SILVIA 2 20'. Only the wording seen is drawn; plaque size is an estimate.

lanterns.trust: IMG_2656 shows two black hanging lanterns in 22-44; IMG_2669/2670 one in 2-20. Positions estimated.

gate.trust: IMG_2669/2670: beyond the arch, two black iron-bar gate leaves either side of a white central pier carrying a house-number plaque, with a white lintel and trained bougainvillea overhead. Garden beyond is not modelled. The 22-44 arch opens onto a planted garden path (IMG_2656), with no gate seen.

planting.2-20: Two large potted foliage plants stand either side of the garden gate arch, and begonia boxes with red flowers sit on the left and right at the porch (IMG_2669/2670).
planting.22-44: A white rendered planter wall with a rounded end holds jade plants along the left of the flight, and a matching one on the right beside the doors (IMG_2656/2657/2574). Agave and clipped shrubs stand in front of the arch.
planting.trust: Details-level only; species and counts are schematic.
